note: Provenance is checked against this registry, and independence needs an onboarding record. The only registered signer is the author, whose attestations verify and are explicitly not independent; the reviewer slot is empty on purpose.

agent://session-author.note: wrote these cases and reviews them; a verified author attestation proves the payload was not altered, not that anyone independent looked at it

onboarding.declaration: wrote the cases; an author review is not independent

onboarding_policy.requires_authorization: onboarding.authorized_by must name the human who approved the role
onboarding_policy.no_self_onboarding: a reviewer may not authorize their own independence
onboarding_policy.independence_declared: onboarding.independent must be true for benchmark eligibility
onboarding_policy.not_the_author: the onboarding record must state that the reviewer did not author the cases

awaiting_external_reviewer.note: No independent reviewer is registered. This slot is deliberately not a reviewer entry: a public key generated by this project cannot stand in for one, and no key is provisioned here.
requirements: a person or organisation unaffiliated with the case author
their own Ed25519 key, generated and held by them
an onboarding record with authorized_by naming the human who approved the role
signed attestations for the selected frozen cases
